Subject: Promotion packet: Priya Natarajan — evidence routing and redaction path

Hi team,

I'm pulling together Priya's level-change packet for the upcoming committee on 5/26. Two operational asks as we start:

1) Evidence ownership: Monica, can you confirm you'll consolidate the compact evidence bundle? Ideally one ZIP and a short index doc listing the artifacts (pull requests, customer notes, peer feedback, metrics).

2) Redaction workflow: we have two items that need vendor redaction (customer names in support logs). I don't want those in the committee Google folder without redaction applied. I propose we send the bundle to PeopleOps Redaction and have them return a redacted ZIP plus a redaction report. Monica — can you coordinate submission?

Priyom — please draft a 2-paragraph advocacy note and 3 bullets on the impact metrics (latency improvements, cost per inference delta, ownership examples) by 5/18 so I can include it.

Timeline: final packet ready 5/21 AM Pacific; committee read by 5/24; committee on 5/26. If any of these dates are impossible, flag immediately.

Attachments: I'll upload the raw artifacts to the Drive link below once Monica confirms the bundle.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson

Hi Monica — thanks for the heads up. We can take this. Please submit the ZIP via our secure upload (we will send a link). Our standard SLA for a bundle this size is 24–36 hours, redaction report included (we flag any ambiguous PII for client review).

Checklist for submission:
- ZIP filename must contain candidate name and a date (e.g., PRIYA_NATARAN_EVIDENCE_20270518.zip)
- Include the index.csv in the root of the ZIP
- Note any specific terms to keep vs redact in redaction_instructions.md

We will scope strictly to customer-identifying information and IP claims; unless you ask otherwise we will not redact code snippets.

PeopleOps Redaction Support
CivDocs Redaction Services

Thanks — quick update from my side:

- Advocacy note: drafted two paragraphs (attached below).
- Impact bullets: 1) 18% reduction in tail latency for prioritized customers; 2) decreased inference cost by ~11% after quantization experiment; 3) ownership of cross-team rollout for new batching policy.
- Committee blackout: I'm unavailable 5/25–5/26 AM; if committee timing is strictly 5/26 late morning Pacific I won't be able to present live — can arrange a live backup (Laura said she'd cover earlier).

Forwarding draft advocacy note below for insertion into the packet. Monica — once you upload the final ZIP please confirm the upload link so I can reference exact filenames in the note.

---- Forwarded draft ----
Priya Natarajan — Advocacy (for committee):
Priya has led the inference performance effort across three quarters, driving measurable reductions in both latency and serving cost while owning the rollout to internal and external customers. Her proposals for continuous batching and smart prefix caching reduced tail latencies for key enterprise customers and enabled a reliable path to reduced unit costs.

Her leadership in cross-team coordination and in mentoring junior engineers has been critical to sustaining the improvements. I recommend Priya for a level change based on sustained impact, technical breadth, and mentorship.

—Priyom
